explanation: Soaking maize (corn) in alkaline limewater, called nixtamalization, frees the vitamin niacin. Where maize spread without the method, as in parts of Europe, the deficiency disease pellagra followed.

claims.text: For tortillas, maize is traditionally cooked and soaked in limewater (a solution of calcium hydroxide) before grinding, a process called nixtamalization.
Wheat, rice and barley are not the grain nixtamalized for tortilla dough.
Nixtamalization makes the niacin in maize available to the body.
Where maize became a staple without nixtamalization, as in parts of southern Europe, the niacin-deficiency disease pellagra became common.
